items.title: Victor Peng Sees AI, Quantum Computing as Long-Term Opportunities
items.summary: Victor Peng, CEO of PsiQuantum and former Advanced Micro Devices president, says quantum computing and optical switching could lower compute costs on "Bloomberg The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Anthropic IPO Could  Mark End of the AI Trade
items.summary: Anna Wong, Bloomberg Economics Chief US Economist warns Anthropic’s slice of the token market has narrowed: and that the hyperscaler has surrendered a substantial part of its price premium without strengthening its competitive position. That’s a warning that enterprises may be moving workloads to cheaper models, weakening Anthropic’s pricing power. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Zscaler stock jumps 18% on report that CrowdStrike in talks to buy security vendor
items.summary: Cybersecurity companies have been hunting for acquisitions in the AI era.

items.title: Anthropic falls nearly 9% in first full day of trading as tech stocks get shellacked
items.summary: Anthropic opened at $111.50 per share on Thursday, but closed at $97.17, which was 17% above the $83 IPO price.

items.title: Anthropic defied the odds in its record IPO. Now it has to reckon with AI market turbulence
items.summary: Anthropic faced a market sell-off, raging anti-AI sentiment and a crisis at Nvidia in pulling off the largest IPO on record.

items.title: CrowdStrike Is in Talks to Buy Cybersecurity Firm Zscaler
items.summary: CrowdStrike Holdings Inc. is in talks to acquire Zscaler Inc., according to people familiar with the matter, in a deal that would be among the largest-ever in the cybersecurity sector.

items.title: Gap names new Athleta CEO, says Old Navy turnaround is seeing signs of progress
items.summary: Gap on Thursday announced Ashley Kechter as the new CEO of Athleta. The retailer also reported mixed fiscal third-quarter earnings.

items.title: In the AI race with the US, this is the one advantage China has - The Straits Times
JPMorgan Gets Lowballed Below 80 Cents for Qualtrics Hung Debt
items.summary: JPMorgan Chase & Co. is fielding rock-bottom offers from investors as it weighs a potential debt sale tied to an acquisition by Qualtrics International Inc.

items.title: Bayer’s $7.25 Billion Roundup Settlement Approved by Judge
items.summary: A Missouri judge approved a Bayer AG proposal to contain its mounting legal costs by paying as much as $7.25 billion to resolve tens of thousands of US lawsuits by people who blame the company’s Roundup weedkiller for their cancers.

items.title: Trump vows to stop U.S. companies from building data centers abroad, threatens 'tremendous tax'
items.summary: Trump spoke at the White House after meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin for a historic trilateral summit in China.

items.title: Cognition in Talks for $75 Billion Value With New Funding
items.summary: Artificial intelligence coding startup Cognition AI Inc. is in funding talks at a $75 billion valuation, just two months after announcing its most recent funding round, according to people familiar with the matter.

items.title: Canadian Stocks Enter a Correction as Metals, Tech Slip
items.summary: A key benchmark of Canadian equities entered a technical correction on Friday as a selloff pushed metals, technology and energy stocks lower.

items.title: Jensen Huang to testify publicly before Senate banking panel, Chairman Scott says
items.summary: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has faced a flurry of criticism on Capitol Hill in the wake of his involvement with a suspected Chinese spy.

items.title: ‘Grand Theft Auto VI’ Sells $3.79 Billion, Making It Biggest Entertainment Launch Ever
items.summary: The best-reviewed game ever is also the fastest-selling

items.title: Odd Lots: Minerva Co-Founder on the Risks of “Abliterated” Models
items.summary: On this episode of the Odd Lots podcast, Minerva Co-Founder Daniel Saedi joins Joe Weisenthal and Tracy Alloway to unpack how his company mixes and matches AI models for specific use cases and the risk of “abliterated” models. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Utility ETFs to Buy as Data Center Electricity Usage Is Set to Double by 2030 - The Globe and Mail
ECB Must Bring Inflation Back to 2%, France’s Moulin Says
items.summary: European Central Bank Governing Council member Emmanuel Moulin said policymakers still have work to do to restore price stability.

items.title: Cloud Infrastructure Firm CloudFerro Is Said to Weigh Warsaw IPO
items.summary: Polish cloud infrastructure provider CloudFerro SA is considering an initial public offering in Warsaw as soon as next year, according to people familiar with the matter.

items.title: Anthropic Falls After Blockbuster Debut as Tech Sells Off
items.summary: Anthropic shares erased much of their first-day surge as the record-breaking listing faces its first test from public investors. Bloomberg's Shirin Ghaffary discusses what's ahead for the company with Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Altruist’s Wenk on AI and the Next Era of Financial Advice
items.summary: Altruist CEO Jason Wenk joins Bloomberg's Katie Greifeld for a wide ranging conversation on what joining Vanguard could mean for Altruist, his push to make financial advice more accessible and how technology and AI could reshape the economics of wealth management. He also addresses the future of the RIA custody market and Altruist’s plans to expand its product offering. Wenk spoke at the Bloomberg ETFs in Depth conference in New York on November 19, 2026. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: GTA VI Earns Near-Perfect Reviews in Record Launch
items.summary: Grand Theft Auto VI has finally arrived — and Bloomberg’s Jason Schreier calls it a “masterpiece” after spending more than 45 hours with the game. He discusses the extraordinary detail and scale of Rockstar’s latest blockbuster, the record demand surrounding its launch and how GTA VI earned a 99 score on Metacritic, making it the highest-rated game ever on the review aggregator. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Anthropic Slides as AI Selloff Deepens
items.summary: Bloomberg’s Ed Ludlow takes a look at Anthropic shares falling after its blockbuster stock market debut, as part of a wider global tech selloff hitting the AI trade. And: Grand Theft Auto 6 has finally arrived with record-breaking demand. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Anthropic Investor Sees Huge Runway Beyond Coding
items.summary: Anthropic shares are retreating after their blockbuster debut, but T. Rowe Price’s Emma Norchet says the volatility doesn’t change the firm’s long-term outlook. One of Anthropic’s largest private investors, T. Rowe also participated in the IPO. Norchet discusses the company’s improving compute economics and the growth opportunity beyond coding, from knowledge work and cybersecurity to biology and robotics. She joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Fed’s Paulson Argues for Deliberate Rate Hikes to Tame Inflation
items.summary: Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia President Anna Paulson said she’d be open to considering back-to-back interest-rate hikes at the central bank’s upcoming policy meetings to help contain inflation, but said officials should move at a “deliberate” pace.

items.title: Bitcoin's regulation bull case is played out. What could drive crypto gains moving forward
items.summary: Crypto investors are looking beyond Congress for the next catalyst after the Senate failed to advance the Clarity Act in September.

AI Selloff Spurs Haven Demand for Yen, Franc as Dollar Slips
items.summary: The Japanese yen and Swiss franc outperformed their major peers as growing doubts about the sustainability of the artificial intelligence boom drove demand for havens and put pressure on the US dollar.

items.title: France Picks Boone to Run Markets at ECB in Pivotal Crisis Role
items.summary: France nominated one of President Emmanuel Macron’s former ministers for a senior European Central Bank position that may prove key in the event of a bond crisis.

items.title: Romania Needs Further Deficit Cuts to Boost Confidence, IMF Says
items.summary: The International Monetary Fund called on Romania to lower the fiscal deficit further in order to maintain investors’ confidence and said higher interest rates may be needed to contain inflation risks.

items.title: CIEN Targets a $50B Market: How AI Could Expand Its Growth Opportunity - The Globe and Mail
US Credit-Fear Hits 8-Month High as Tech Angst Roils Markets
items.summary: Measures of perceived US credit risk reached levels not seen in nearly eight months and the cost of protecting the debt of some of the biggest tech firms against default jumped on Friday, as the wobbling AI trade spurred volatility in global markets and sent investors piling into safe havens.

items.title: Brits Should Have to Complete Mandatory Surveys, UK Stats Body Suggests
items.summary: Britain’s statistics authority appears close to backing a change in the law that would require households to complete key economic surveys.
